$comment: Frozen once written. Declares, per key, the exact string the rebuilt app must render where the rename table changes vocabulary. The gate additionally asserts every numeric token survives unchanged.

Scope: exactly the 38 keys of tests/baseline.json whose baseline text carries a term retired by docs/redesign-spec.md 3.1, outside glossary.*. scripts/classify-keys.mjs derives that set from the baseline and fails if this file does not match it key-for-key.

The set was 37 until reconciliation.status_line was found rendering the retired terms as the bare words "Derived" and "Revised", with no "MV" suffix. The scan now includes those bare terms. Matching is plain substring, not word-boundary anchored, because the harness reads textContent and adjacent labels concatenate with no separator — see the comment in scripts/classify-keys.mjs.
The other 982 baseline keys stay STRICT: byte-identical to tests/baseline.json. A relabel that is not declared here is a gate FAILURE, never a pass.

glossary.* is excluded by design: 12 glossary keys still mention the retired terms, because the glossary is where a controller looks up what the old label meant. Those keys keep the original wording and stay strict.

expected was derived by applying "vocabulary" to the baseline string and then reading the result. Where the mechanical substitution read badly — a term used as a noun mid-sentence, a subtitle that restated the old label, an arithmetic clause — the entry carries a hand-written sentence and a "note" saying why. That is why this map is per key and not a find-and-replace.
In running prose the declared terms appear in sentence case (e.g. "look-through value"); as a label or column head they appear as declared.

DIGIT GUARD: for every entry, numericTokens(expected) must deep-equal numericTokens(baseline), where numericTokens(s) = every match of the numeric-token regex in scripts/lib/parity.mjs, commas stripped, in order. Words may change; digits may not. Two figures rendered adjacent with no separator therefore read as one token and must stay adjacent (see pricing.detail.*.price_equations).
Neither parity-map.json nor tests/baseline.json is edited by this mechanism.

The original asserts ownership is "verified to conserve"; it is not, for 5 of 514 entities (ABFSUB6 129.29% via ABFAGB, MIDCAP 3.10%, APVCIAGA/APVCIAGB/APVCIINA just short), because of the circular holdings the Data quality lens reports as High. Rendering the original verbatim would hand a controller a false control statement. The numeric token 100 is preserved, so no figure moves. See docs/issues.md.
